about.title: Who we are
about.lead: An inclusive and intercultural platform for climate action, youth training and food sovereignty in Africa.
about.visionText: A resilient African continent where young people have the capabilities to meaningfully advance environmental conservation and sustainable agroecological development.
about.missionText: YAAC is an inclusive and intercultural platform in the fight against climate change, the training of young people, and the fight against hunger in Africa.
about.valuesLead: Five principles guide every project we run.

values.name: Inclusion
values.text: Everyone has a place in the alliance, regardless of background, gender or training.

values.name: Environment protection
values.text: Every action is measured against its impact on ecosystems and biodiversity.

values.name: Poverty alleviation
values.text: Agroecology is a lever for dignified livelihoods, not only for conservation.

values.name: Integrity
values.text: Transparency in how we work, spend and report to our communities and partners.

values.name: Local adaptation
values.text: Solutions are rooted in the knowledge and realities of each territory.

about.teamText: Our team brings together expertise in agroecology, project management, communications, entrepreneurship and the social sciences — a deliberate mix that lets us move from field practice to public advocacy.

news.title: News
news.lead: Field actions, YAAC Talks, and what we learn along the way.

partners.title: Stronger Together for Change
partners.lead: We build long-term relationships with institutions that share our commitment to agroecology and climate justice.
partners.whyLead: Four reasons organisations choose to work with YAAC.

why.name: Community impact
why.text: Our projects are designed with the communities that live them, so results outlast the funding cycle.

why.name: Sustainable practices
why.text: Agroecology is at the core of every intervention — restoring soils, water and biodiversity together.

why.name: Shared resources
why.text: Pooled expertise, training material and field data, openly accessible to our partners.

why.name: Local rootedness
why.text: A youth network anchored across African territories, able to act quickly and close to the ground.

partners.volunteerText: Give your time and skills to concrete climate action. Volunteers support our field operations, training sessions and public campaigns.
